Sorella Forte Saturday Ride

Portland, OR · Central Eastside · Road

Women / trans / femmeNo-drop

Sorella Forte Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Portland, OR. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from River City Bicycles parking lot. About 25–40 miles, no-drop, roughly 11–16 mph; the shop lists 14–19 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 11–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @sorellaforte the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sorella Forte Saturday Ride group ride

A weekly road ride for women, trans and non-binary cyclists. Rolls out of the River City Bicycles lot and is usually back by noon. Nobody gets left behind; the group fixes flats and regroups at major points.
